items.title: Cirra Studio
items.description: A clothing brand concept for people with skin conditions and sensitive skin, paired with its debut collection. The garments are lightweight and flattering, made of silk satin and semi-sheer chiffon with covered seams and linings to minimize irritation.

items.title: Sense Collection
items.description:
The collection reimagines clothing as a multi-sensory experience
focusing on three senses: sight, touch and smell. The
garments combine hand-dyed textiles from natural plantbased
dyes, subtle scent sachets activated by movement, and
tactile elements such as pleats and gatherings.

items.title: Resort '25
items.description:
The concept stems from personal reflections on childhood:
warm summer days spent outdoors, the softness of meadow
wildflowers, the peach glow of sunsets, and the simple joy of
fresh fruit at a picnic.
